mapper.insert: INSERT INTO store (name, region, city,district,address,is_active) VALUES (#{name}, #{region}, #{city},#{district},#{address},#{isActive})
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM store WHERE 1=1
AND region = #{region}
AND ( city = #{subRegion} OR ((city IS NULL OR city = '') AND district = #{subRegion}) )
AND is_active = 1 AND closed_at IS NULL AND open_at IS NOT NULL AND open_at <= NOW()
AND is_active = 1 AND closed_at IS NULL AND open_at > NOW()
AND is_active = 1 AND closed_at IS NULL AND open_at IS NULL
AND closed_at IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store WHERE 1=1
AND region = #{region}
AND ( city = #{subRegion} OR (city IS NULL AND district = #{subRegion}) )
AND is_active = 1 AND closed_at IS NULL AND open_at IS NOT NULL AND open_at <= NOW()
AND is_active = 1 AND closed_at IS NULL AND open_at > NOW()
AND is_active = 1 AND closed_at IS NULL AND open_at IS NULL
AND closed_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,
-- 운영중 SUM(CASE WHEN is_active = 1 AND closed_at IS NULL AND open_at IS NOT NULL AND open_at <= NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS operating,
-- 오픈 예정 SUM(CASE WHEN is_active = 1 AND closed_at IS NULL AND open_at > NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS scheduled,
-- 폐점 SUM(CASE WHEN closed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed,
-- 오픈 미정 SUM(CASE WHEN is_active = 1 AND closed_at IS NULL AND open_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inactive
FROM store
SELECT open_at AS openAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM store WHERE id = #{storeId}

SELECT DISTINCT district FROM store WHERE region = #{region} AND district IS NOT NULL
AND city = #{city}
AND city IS NULL
ORDER BY district
SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS count FROM store GROUP BY region ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT id,created_at AS createdAt,region,name from store where is_active=1 AND open_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
